_comment: Geo-only flood probes (2026-06-22). Each query implies LAC geography (inferGeographyFromQuery fires) but matches NO SCL_TOPICS keyword (inferTopicsFromQuery === []), forcing the topicGeoChannel geo-only path that pulls ANY LAC paper regardless of subject. Verified clean of every SCL keyword incl. the bare 'ai' substring and labor's 'taxing wages'/'informality'. These have NO canaries — they measure PRECISION/NOISE (meanCos, offTopic, tgCount, tgMeanCos), not recall. Used by scripts/probe-topicgeo-hyde-ablation.mjs via --extra. NOT part of the canonical gold set (kept out of evals/queries.json so eval-gold/baseline are unaffected).

queries.query: How does corporate income tax enforcement affect government revenue collection in Latin America and the Caribbean?
queries.intent: Fiscal capacity / tax administration topic with no SCL keyword. Relevant LAC papers exist (tax-enforcement RCTs, audit studies). Flood test: does topicGeo inject off-topic LAC papers (health, education, gender) because geography alone matched?

queries.query: What is the effect of central bank independence and monetary policy credibility on price stability in Latin America?
queries.intent: Monetary policy topic with no SCL keyword (avoids social_protection's 'targeting'). Relevant LAC macro literature exists. Flood test as above.

queries.query: What is the impact of public investment in road and transport infrastructure on regional economic development in Brazil and Mexico?
queries.intent: Infrastructure / transport economics topic with no SCL keyword. Relevant LAC papers exist. Flood test as above.
